name: Wand of Teeth

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Ten charges (1d10 back at dawn): 1 to 3 charges spray a 30-ft Cone of teeth, 1d8 Piercing per charge and Poisoned.
text: This wand has 10 charges and regains 1d10 expended charges each dawn; when you spend the last one, roll a d20 and on a 1 it crumbles. While holding it, as a Magic action you can spend 1 to 3 charges to spray teeth in a 30-foot Cone: each creature there makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 Piercing damage per charge and having the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half the damage on a success.
